title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
constraints: target is a node in the given tree
inputFormat: Implement distanceK(root, target, k). The runner converts the level-order root array into nodes with val, left, and right fields. The target value selects the corresponding node object in that tree.
outputFormat: An array of values of all nodes exactly k edges from target, in any order. Return [] if none exist.
